Here’s Where I’m Buying Apple By InTheMoneyStocks.com (Gareth Soloway) Stock Markets 4 hours ago (Feb 02, 2018 02:22PM ET) www.investing.com/analysis/heres-where-im-buying-apple-200286572 Here’s Where I’m Buying Apple By InTheMoneyStocks.com (Gareth Soloway) | 4 hours ago (Feb 02, 2018 02:22PM ET) This article has already been saved in your Saved Items Follow 
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) continues to fall after reporting earnings on Thursday. The stock fell into the release on worries about the super-cycle and earnings did not help the picture. As a swing trader, I'm watching $157.50 for a bounce. This is a technical support and a gap fill. Look for a solid bounce back to $165. Apple
